_notice: PROVISIONAL, TECHNOLOGY-AGNOSTIC link-capacity profiles. All values are modelling ASSUMPTIONS, not measurements of any real radio technology (in particular NOT measured Wi-Fi performance). Positive Shannon capacity is NOT evidence of a usable link. Link availability for candidate discovery remains the 1000 m geographic range used by the LSTM labels.

abstract_sidelink_v0.description: Log-distance path loss + Shannon capacity with an implementation-efficiency factor and a spectral-efficiency cap. Provisional placeholder pending the choice of wireless technology.

_units.carrier_frequency_ghz: GHz (only sets free-space loss at the reference distance)
_units.antenna_gains_dbi: dBi, sum of Tx and Rx gains
_units.reporting_snr_floor_db: dB; used ONLY to flag low-SNR rows in statistics, never for eligibility
